packMeta.name: CleanShift (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey cleaning business scheduler: crew dispatch board, client access instructions, teams roster, quality checklists & star ratings, supply par stock, and client issues desk. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
